# govengers/jobs

> Durable PostgreSQL work queue for govengers services: typed kinds, enqueue inside the caller's transaction, lease plus heartbeat with lease-token fencing, retry with backoff, Permanent and Snooze outcomes, leaderless rescuer, retention and schedules, graceful drain and release, adapters for wide events, auth identity and Prometheus.

- Module: `github.com/govengers/jobs`, Go 1.26, PostgreSQL 18, Apache 2.0.
- Packages: `jobs` (model, outcomes, worker, Store/Observer/Propagator interfaces), `postgresadapter` (Store on pgx/v5, Enqueue, admin operations, QueueDepths, MigrationV1), `wideeventadapter`, `authadapter`, `prometheusadapter`, `jobstest` (Drain).
- Standards: govengers/standards, `library` profile.
- Rule of thumb: jobs stay inside one service and its database; delivery is at least once, so handlers are idempotent; a handler is a job controller that calls a service method.

- [docs/wiki/Schedules.md](docs/wiki/Schedules.md): recurring jobs once per period.

- [docs/wiki/Observability.md](docs/wiki/Observability.md): wide events, metrics (aggregate depth with max), identity, Observer.
- [docs/wiki/Testing.md](docs/wiki/Testing.md): jobstest.Drain, embedded Postgres, the end-to-end suite.
- [docs/wiki/Migration.md](docs/wiki/Migration.md): replacing a hand-rolled Postgres queue.
- [docs/wiki/Gotchas.md](docs/wiki/Gotchas.md): the rules that are easy to get wrong.
- [docs/design.md](docs/design.md): the binding design, decisions J1 onwards (jobs) and E1-E11 (events, a separate module).
- [examples/signup](examples/signup): a tested example service.
